subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits to requestTimeoutMs

question: After the unrelated APNs exception is removed, should Codex WebSocket and Unix upgrades fail at the resolved `appServer.requestTimeoutMs` budget with transport exit 1006?
rationale: The implementation fixes an indefinite hang without adding configuration, but it intentionally converts unusually slow existing upgrades into failures and upstream labels TCP WebSocket transport experimental.

options.title: Reuse request timeout
options.body: Approve the existing request timeout as the shared handshake ceiling for TCP and Unix transports after removing the APNs exception.

options.title: Add separate handshake policy
options.body: Require a separately reviewed timeout surface only if operators need handshake timing independent from RPC timing.

options.title: Pause the transport change
options.body: Keep the previous indefinite behavior until a different compatibility contract and production proof are agreed.

recommendation.title: Reuse request timeout
recommendation.body: Approve the existing request timeout as the shared handshake ceiling for TCP and Unix transports after removing the APNs exception.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Codex app-server harness merge provides the clearest ownership and decision trail for this transport contract.
